shortDescription: Manage allowed IPs using openAPI on F5OS based systems

options.name: allowed
options.description: Specify Name, IP Address, Prefix Length and Port for an allowed address

options.name: state
options.description: Allowed IPs state of F5OS system If C(present), Specified Allowed IPs configuration will be pushed to F5OS system. If C(absent), deletes the Allowed IPs configuration if it exists.
